title: Injection with one contradiction and one knowledge failure: ESCALATE vs FREEZE proof
description: An otherwise-honest Dana call (identity, request, every readback confirmed, all lookups PASS) with an injection line, one claim that's later contradicted (approver), and one knowledge challenge with a wrong answer (payment purpose). Under old tally (ruling B 2026-09-09), injection counted 1 + one contradiction 1 + one knowledge fail 1 = tally 3, triggering row 8 FREEZE. Ruling 6 (2026-09-15) removes injection from tally, so tally = 1 + 1 = 2, which does not trigger the tally >= 3 freeze rule; instead, the call escalates at row 14 (human callback). This fixture proves the behavioral difference by measuring tally against the exact 3-failure freeze threshold.
